name: thinkcomposer
description: Work safely with ThinkComposer packages through canonical snapshots, operation patches, Domain definition-detail persistence, multi-point routing validation, CLI workflows, reports, logs, and previews.

interface.shortDescription: Safely edit and validate ThinkComposer packages
interface.longDescription: ThinkComposer lets Codex inspect canonical .tcom/.tdom snapshot JSON and previews, prepare standalone operation patches, preserve Domain definition Details and instance values with Domain JSON v2, preview and apply changes through the ThinkComposer CLI, validate multi-point Relationship routing, preserve Git metadata, generate reports and output files, inspect logs, and visually verify saved views.
defaultPrompt: Apply a safe patch to a .tcom/.tdom package
